description: One WWDC session: its title, year and topics; its links, including the video downloads and the documentation it covers; its chapters; the full transcript, each paragraph with its time; every code example with the time it appears; and the sessions Apple lists as related. Transcripts are long: set includeTranscript to false when you need only the code or the links. view "related" lists the sessions related to it instead: those Apple lists, then, across every year, those that share the most of its topics.

includeCode.description: session: false leaves out the code examples.

includeTranscript.description: session: false leaves out the transcript, which runs to tens of KB.

videoId.description: The session's number, from its link: …/wwdc2025/10101/ is "10101".

view.description: "session": the session itself. "related": the sessions related to it, first those Apple lists as related, then, across every year, sessions that share its topics, the most shared first; each with its year, link and topics, and whether it has a transcript and code.
